name: @papercusp/facets
description: A domain-free faceted-filtering core. Given a list of rows of any type T and a set of facet definitions (each knowing how to extract 0..N values from a row), it tallies value counts, hides facets that can't filter (single-value), sorts + caps values, and builds the AND-across / OR-within filter predicate — all from the ACTUAL rows, so both the facets shown and their values reflect only what is present. Pure, sync, no React. The domain knowledge lives entirely in the caller-supplied `extract(row)` closures; the lib carries the algorithm.
